grade_rationale: Automatic F: confirmed red-team breach of critical objectives (RED-001 full workflow takeover, RED-003 unauthorized cascade dispatch). Compliance pass rate 19% is also below the 60% floor for grade C.

findings.title: No Authentication or Authorization on Any API Endpoint
findings.owasp: A01: Broken Access Control, A07: Identification and Authentication Failures
findings.description: Every API route is exposed without any authentication or authorization middleware. Any unauthenticated caller can create, read, update, delete, approve, reject, or dispatch any work item. This is the root cause enabling all critical exploit chains.
findings.remediation: Implement JWT bearer-token authentication as the first app.use() call before route registration. Introduce RBAC with roles: viewer, triage-agent, approver, dispatcher, admin. Unauthenticated requests must receive HTTP 401; insufficient-role requests HTTP 403. Machine callers use a distinct API-key mechanism.

findings.title: Unrestricted overrideRoute: fast-track Bypasses Entire Assessment Pipeline
findings.owasp: A01: Broken Access Control, A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.description: POST /api/work-items/:id/route accepts caller-supplied overrideRoute: 'fast-track' which causes classifyRoute() to return WorkItemStatus.Approved unconditionally — assessment pod never invoked, assessments array remains empty. Red-team confirmed 3-request unauthenticated chain: backlog→approved→in-progress.
findings.remediation: After authentication (CF-001), gate overrideRoute to ops-manager role. Require mandatory audit event with approver identity. Consider removing the escape hatch from the public API surface entirely.

findings.title: Unauthorized Cascade Auto-Dispatch via Dependency Injection
findings.description: Any caller can inject an attacker-controlled blocker onto an approved victim item, then reject the blocker to trigger onItemResolved(), which auto-dispatches the victim via cascade-dispatcher — bypassing the explicit /dispatch endpoint. Confirmed via changeHistory and Prometheus counter.
findings.remediation: Restrict POST /dependencies (add blocker) to ops-manager role for approved items. Make onItemResolved cascade dispatch emit a notification/approval event rather than directly mutating state. Implement a 2-phase commit confirmation before auto-dispatch.

findings.title: Intake Webhooks — No HMAC Signature + Enum Injection + Stored XSS
findings.owasp: A03: Injection, A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.description: POST /api/intake/zendesk and /api/intake/automated accept arbitrary POSTs with no HMAC-SHA256 signature check. type and priority fields are not validated against enums. Red-team stored priority: '' and type: 'INVALID_ENUM_TYPE' verbatim.
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256 against env-var shared secret using crypto.timingSafeEqual(). Require API-key header for /automated. Validate type and priority against enums, returning HTTP 400 for invalid values.

findings.title: Unbounded Pagination Enables Full Dataset Exfiltration
findings.description: GET /api/work-items?limit=999999 returns all records. GET /api/dashboard/queue dumps all items with no pagination. limit=0 returns all items; limit=-1 returns N-1 items (JS slice edge case). Full audit trail exposed via dashboard/activity.
findings.remediation: Cap limit server-side: Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(q) || 20, 1), 100). Reject negative/zero values with HTTP 400. Add pagination to /dashboard/queue. Require authentication.

findings.title: Missing Required Audit Events + No Authenticated Actor Identity in Audit Log
findings.owasp: A09: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.description: security.config.yml requires login_attempt, permission_denied, state_transition, and data_export audit events — zero are emitted as structured log events. changeHistory uses generic strings ('user', 'system') not authenticated identities. Structurally impossible until CF-001 is fixed.
findings.remediation: After CF-001, extract authenticated user ID from request context and pass as agent to buildChangeEntry(). Emit structured log entries with eventType field on every state-mutating operation. Persist audit logs to append-only store.

findings.title: Soft-Deleted Item UUID Disclosure via Readiness Check
findings.description: GET /api/work-items/:id/ready returns unresolvedBlockers including raw DependencyLink objects for soft-deleted blockers. Deleted UUID and docId disclosed. Secondary: soft-deleted blocker permanently strands dependent (DoS vector).
findings.remediation: On soft-delete, remove item from all dependent blockedBy arrays. Replace blocker UUIDs in readiness response with anonymized indicator (blockerDeleted: true).

findings.title: NeedsClarification Assessment Verdict Silently Bypasses Dispatch Gating
findings.description: runAssessmentPod() maps NeedsClarification to WorkItemStatus.Rejected. Since Rejected is in RESOLVED_STATUSES, dependents are unblocked. Dispatch gating relies on stale hasUnresolvedBlockers flag — confirmed: dispatch succeeded on item with hasUnresolvedBlockers: true.
findings.remediation: Map NeedsClarification to a distinct status. Exclude from RESOLVED_STATUSES. Make dispatch gating re-compute live blocker states rather than relying on cached hasUnresolvedBlockers flag.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers (helmet not installed)
findings.description: No security headers set. Missing: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.remediation: npm install helmet; app.use(helmet()) as first middleware. Tune CSP for API context.

findings.title: No CORS Policy Configured
findings.description: No CORS middleware configured. Risk of permissive wildcard misconfiguration when one is eventually added.
findings.remediation: npm install cors; app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') ?? [] })).

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics Endpoint
findings.description: GET /metrics exposes business counters (workflow_items_created_total, dispatch_gating_events_total, cycle_detection_events_total, etc.) to any unauthenticated caller.
findings.remediation: Restrict to localhost (req.ip check), add bearer token, or bind to separate internal port.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.description: No rate-limit middleware. Unlimited req/s enables resource exhaustion and brute-force.
findings.remediation: npm install express-rate-limit. Apply global 100 req/min/IP; stricter on mutation endpoints. Return HTTP 429 with Retry-After.

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement at Application Level
findings.description: No HTTPS redirect middleware or HSTS header. Future auth tokens transit unencrypted unless reverse proxy enforces TLS.
findings.remediation: Enforce TLS at reverse proxy. Add HTTP→HTTPS redirect when NODE_ENV=production. Configure HSTS via helmet (CF-009).

findings.title: In-Memory Store — No Persistence or Encryption at Rest
findings.description: All state in a JS Map; data lost on restart; no encryption at rest; changeHistory mutable in-place.
findings.remediation: Replace with PostgreSQL. Enable disk-level encryption at rest. Keep in-memory store for dev/test only.

findings.title: Raw Exception Messages Exposed in Error Responses
findings.description: Route-level catch blocks in workflow.ts return err.message directly, pre-empting the global errorHandler. Confirmed: nonexistent UUID echoed back in error message.
findings.remediation: Replace route-level catch blocks with next(err). Return generic HTTP 404 {"error":"Not found"} without echoing the ID.

findings.title: Predictable Sequential Document IDs Enable Enumeration
findings.description: generateDocId() uses module-level counter (WI-001, WI-002...). Gaps in sequence reveal soft-deletion events and restart history. Confirmed: 17 items mapped WI-001 through WI-018 with gap at WI-011.
findings.remediation: Use ULID or UUID-derived short codes. Persist counter across restarts.

findings.title: Debug Portal iframe Missing sandbox Attribute
findings.description: iframe embedding the debug portal has no sandbox attribute, granting full DOM access. Default URL uses http:// — mixed-content risk.
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms". Validate portalUrl against an allowlist.

findings.title: Sensitive Field Values Emitted in Change History Logs
findings.owasp: A09: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.description: changeHistory.ts logs oldValue and newValue at INFO level. PII-containing free-text fields indexed by log aggregators indefinitely.
findings.remediation: Truncate strings to 100 chars before logging. For sensitive_fields in security.config.yml, mask or omit the value.

findings.title: No Input Length Validation + No Explicit Body Size Limit
findings.description: Presence checks (!body.title) do not enforce max length. A 50MB title passes validation. Express default body size limit (100KB) not explicitly configured.
findings.remediation: Add title.length <= 500 and description.length <= 10000 checks. Set app.use(express.json({ limit: '10kb' })).

findings.title: Audit Log Lacks Tamper-Evidence (Mutable In-Memory History)
findings.owasp: A09: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.description: WorkItem.changeHistory is overwritten via updateWorkItem() in multiple workflow routes. No append-only audit store.
findings.remediation: Move audit events to separate append-only log store. Remove ability to overwrite changeHistory through normal update API. In database implementation, enforce no UPDATE/DELETE on audit log table.

findings.title: No OpenTelemetry Instrumentation Despite Architecture Mandate
findings.owasp: A09: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
findings.description: CLAUDE.md mandates OpenTelemetry with W3C traceparent propagation. No OTel packages present; logs contain no traceId/spanId fields.
findings.remediation: Install @opentelemetry/sdk-node and @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node. Initialize SDK before Express app. Inject trace/span IDs into logger context.
